reviewed_by: Claude Code, fixing the live deployer stall seen during the Butler home worker promotion
reason: The live dd8e6ae promotion sat blocked for a long time after every project had moved: a faulthandler stack showed StagedDeployer._move_projects re-reading deployment status once per project, and deployment status lists every project (~1,021 on live), so each pass did ~1,000 full status reads. A pass that only skips already-moved projects now reuses one status read; an iteration that acts on Core (prepare, handoff, retire) clears it so the next project reads fresh state. The same change was hot-patched onto the installed deployer, which then completed the journal. Selected: tests/test_staged_deployer.py, including a new regression test that counts status reads with 200 already-moved projects (210 reads before the fix, 11 after).
exclusions: Only the staged deployer's project loop changed; nebula_deployer.py and Core are untouched, so no other suite exercises this path.
